outcome: Damage dealt to a permanent that is not a battle, creature or planeswalker has no result.
Each attacking and blocking creature deals combat damage equal to its power in the combat damage step.
A spell or ability deals damage from the source it specifies.
Damage from a source without infect to a player makes that player lose that much life.
Damage from an infect source to a player gives that player that many poison counters instead of life loss.
Damage to a planeswalker removes that many loyalty counters.
Damage from a wither or infect source to a creature puts that many -1/-1 counters on it.
Damage from a source with neither wither nor infect is marked on the creature.
Damage from a lifelink source also makes its controller gain that much life.
Combat damage to a player from a toxic creature also gives that player poison counters equal to its toxic value.
Damage to a battle removes that many defense counters.
Damage passes through excess redirection, replacement and prevention, and conversion to results before the damage event occurs.
Excess damage beyond lethal, loyalty or defense is redirected to another permanent or player when the effect says so, with deathtouch making any damage beyond 1 excess.
Replacement and prevention effects modify the damage amount, and damage-dealt triggers fire.
Replacement effects on results such as life gain or counters apply to the processed damage results.
The damage event occurs with the final modified results.
Damage marked on a creature leads to its destruction only through a later state-based check, not by the damage itself.
Marked damage persists until cleanup or regeneration, and a creature with marked damage at least its toughness is destroyed in the state-based check.
A source dealing 0 damage deals no damage, so damage triggers do not fire and damage-increasing or redirecting replacement effects do not apply.
A damage trigger tied to specific sources refers only to the damage those sources dealt.
An excess-damage trigger fires after damage when the sources together dealt more than lethal damage, loyalty or defense, counting the greatest across card types.
